claims: New Caledonia is a special collectivity of France.
New Caledonia is located in the southwest Pacific Ocean.
New Caledonia is located northeast of Australia.
New Caledonia comprises the main island Grande Terre.
Nouméa is the capital of New Caledonia.
New Caledonia comprises several smaller islands.
Grande Terre is the mainland of New Caledonia.
Grande Terre features a central mountain range.
Mont Panié is 1,629 m high.
New Caledonia has a tropical climate modified by trade winds.
New Caledonia is a French overseas territory since 1956.
New Caledonia has a high degree of autonomy.
New Caledonia held three referendums in 2018, 2020, and 2021.
The referendums resulted in votes to remain part of France.
New Caledonia's economy heavily relies on nickel mining.
New Caledonia holds nearly 10% of the world's nickel reserves.
New Caledonia's economy relies on financial support from France.
Indigenous Kanaks make up about 39% of New Caledonia's population.
Anse Vata is a beach in Nouméa.
Baie des Citrons is a beach in Nouméa.
New Caledonia has a UNESCO World Heritage-listed lagoon.
The U.S. State Department advises reconsidering travel to New Caledonia due to potential civil unrest, crimes, and occasional violent protests.
The currency of New Caledonia is the CFP franc (XPF).
The official language of New Caledonia is French.
There is a historical "New Caledonia" district in Canada.
